summary: Redwire Corporation filed an 8-K to supplement pro forma financial information for its prior acquisition of Edge Autonomy (completed June 13, 2025). The filing includes unaudited pro forma condensed combined financial statements for the year ended December 31, 2025. No new transaction terms, prices, premiums, or deadlines are disclosed; the filing is purely a compliance update. The acquisition was previously announced and closed. What to watch: no risk-arb angle remains as the deal is consummated; the filing serves only regulatory completeness.
